Sayonil Mitra

sayonilmitra@gmail.com +91 811 611 4140

Hyderabad, Telangana

linkedin.com/in/sayonil-mitra

github.com/SayonilMitra

PROFILE

Mid-Level Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience designing and building scalable web applications using React, Node.js,

MongoDB, and AWS cloud services. Proven expertise in performance optimization, large-scale data migrations, and automation

pipelines powered by AI APIs. Skilled in architecting full-stack systems under tight deadlines, integrating third-party platforms

(Salesforce, Zendesk), and owning projects from design through CI/CD deployment. Currently delivering high-impact platform

rebuilds and cloud-backed data infrastructure as a Software Engineer at DAZN.

SKILLS

Core Development: React 18, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, MongoDB

Architecture: Microservices, REST API Design, CI/CD Pipelines

Testing: Jest (4,000+ test cases, CI-integrated)

Frameworks & Libraries: React Three Fiber, React Flow, Three.js, Vite, SCSS

AI & Data Visualization: OpenAI APIs, Apache ECharts

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS CloudFront, AWS DynamoDB, AWS S3, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Git, GitHub

Platforms & Tools: Zendesk, Salesforce, DocuSign, Gmail API, Faker.js, Cytoscape

WORK EXPERIENCE

Software Engineer, DAZN

Sept 2025 – Present

Hyderabad, India

All work delivered within DAZN's live customer support ecosystem — serving hundreds of thousands of users daily across

subscriptions, marketing, and help center operations across multiple markets.

Tech used: React 18, Vite, Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, Zendesk, Zendesk App Tools (ZAT), Salesforce, DocuSign, AWS CloudFront, AWS DynamoDB, AWS S3, GitHub Actions, Jest, JavaScript

Built and shipped a full-stack Foxtel Help Center platform from scratch — serving 5,000–10,000 daily users and 1,000+ migrated

articles — as an emergency rebuild after Foxtel's legacy system failed irrecoverably. Designed both the React 18/Vite frontend

and Node.js backend from scratch.

Optimized frontend performance via React lazy loading, code splitting, and Vite build optimizations, reducing page load time by

67% compared to the legacy platform; backend delivery further accelerated through AWS CloudFront CDN integration.

Led the technical execution of a ~1 million record migration from Salesforce to Zendesk — enabling the client to discontinue an

expensive Salesforce Enterprise subscription — including schema design, DynamoDB table architecture, S3-based file storage

for migrated assets, and creation of 200K+ Zendesk user records via high-volume API operations against platform rate limits.

Redesigned the DynamoDB data model for the Help Center and Zendesk custom app — restructuring a monolithic table into

normalized multi-table schemas — to enable efficient CRUD operations and support real-time frontend workflows at scale;

backend APIs implemented in TypeScript for type safety and maintainability.

Engineered CI/CD pipelines for Zendesk custom app deployments using GitHub Actions — automating ZAT bundle validation,

Jest test suite execution (4,000 cases, 95% coverage and pass rate thresholds), and parallel deployment to Zendesk Support

and Sell servers, with post-deployment verification via Zendesk status API polling.

Engineered an end-to-end DocuSign integration — including RSA key-based authentication with automatic token refresh,

contract sending with full UI/brand/content/signature placement customisation, bulk contract dispatch to multiple recipients, and

per-stage audit logging — enabling non-technical users to manage the entire contract workflow without code changes.

Integrated CloudFront cache invalidation via API to ensure real-time content freshness across the Help Center platform.

Maintained and enhanced a production Zendesk custom application — resolving 100+ bugs, implementing UI improvements, and

owning a 4,000-case Jest test suite integrated into the CI/CD deployment pipeline.

Software Engineer, Gaian Solutions

2023 – 2025

Hyderabad, India

Project KYA

Tech used: React, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, REST APIs, Three.js, GitHub, Vite, Cytoscape, OpenAI APIs

Knowledge Management Canvas: Built a configurable canvas interface for file uploads and CRUD operations on structured

data nodes via Node.js REST APIs, with dynamic UI rendering driven by database-stored JSON configs — enabling non-

technical users to manage complex data structures without code changes.

Business Entity Extraction: Designed and deployed a Node.js pipeline leveraging OpenAI vector search APIs to extract

business entities from documents, generate structured entity models, and build enterprise search indexes, improving enterprise-

wide search and discovery.

3D Processor Pipeline: Developed a pipeline to generate primitive 3D objects with OpenAI APIs, converting them into JSON

configs for rendering in simulations.

Project XPX

Tech used: React, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, REST APIs, Three.js, GitHub, Vite, React Three Fiber, React Flow

Website Optimization: Reduced initial load time by 55% (20s → 9s) through React lazy loading and Vite optimizations;

improved Lighthouse score to 98, enhancing user experience.

Dynamic Query Generator: Automated query creation by developing a Node.js service integrated with OpenAI APIs, cutting

generation time by 60% and accelerating data processing.

Synthetic Data Generator: Built a Node.js service with Faker.js to generate large datasets for backend tables, reducing data

preparation time by 90% and improving testing efficiency.

Communication Tracker Service: Built a Node.js service integrating Gmail APIs to monitor and analyze email communication

metrics in real time, automating processing of ~50 emails/hour and reducing backend load by 10%.

3D Workflow Designer: Created an interactive 3D canvas with React Three Fiber and React Drei for drag-and-drop workflow

automation (emails, SMS, etc.); integrated business logic with third-party APIs, reducing manual effort by 40% and improving

engagement management.

Data Orchestration Project

Tech used: React, REST APIs, Apache ECharts, HTML5, CSS

Data Orchestration Platform: Led development of a platform integrating third-party APIs, enabling automated workflows for data

fetching and processing; reduced manual intervention by 60% and improved operational efficiency.

Analytics Dashboard: Built an interactive dashboard with React and Apache ECharts for real-time query visualization,

accelerating data analysis by 50% for internal and client reporting.

Custom Query Features: Extended the analytics dashboard with multi-query selection, dynamic dataset switching, and

customizable chart types using React and Apache ECharts, enabling analysts to explore diverse data structures without

engineering support.

DevOps Automation Project

Tech used: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js

Developed 250+ backend APIs across a microservices architecture integrating with third-party cloud services (AWS, Azure) to

process and return structured data — forming the core data layer for downstream UI consumption.

Integrated a user-friendly API selection UI using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, improving data retrieval efficiency by 40% and

reducing API query time by 30%.

Co-founder, Family Handicrafts Business — Self-employed

Feb 2018 – Nov 2019

Hyderabad, India

Co-managed a social enterprise supporting 10 women artisans across 2 local retail outlets in Santiniketan, returning the majority

of revenue directly to makers. Operations discontinued due to Covid-19.

EDUCATION & TRAINING

IIT Madras — Foundation in B.Sc. Programming and Data Science CGPA 8.3

2020 – 2021

Online

10x Academy — Full Stack Developer Bootcamp

2022 – 2023

Online

University of Sussex — M.Sc. in Financial Mathematics 62%

2016 – 2017

Brighton, UK

Visva Bharati University — B.Sc. in Mathematics 81% West Bengal, India

2012 – 2015
